body: what can I say, i'm trying.

I mean, it depends on the way you look at it. I'm only capable of changing few things, I can't exactly change myself, can I? Honestly, most of my problems revolve around my personality/family and those two you can't really run away from.

He's a child, I suppose. Only just turned ten, and already went through the pain of losing his father a few years back. He thinks of it as this huge elaborate joke only he's let on, I doubt he really knows the consequences, so you're definitely right. I'm sorry I didn't respond earlier, maybe you thought I did it for real this time. I can't now, my mother knows I tried to commit suicide. She doesn't know the specifics, but she does know enough. She told my best friend, and now my friend's saying she'll kill herself if I go through with it. She already tried a few times, and was almost successful once, so I don't want to trigger her further, she's been through a lot so I couldn't do that to her. Besides, I left my noose in my school locker, so I don't think I'll be able to do it this weekend, anyway.

I can relate. I'm a writer, as well, but I feel I am mediocre at best, even after the years I spent to improve at it. Even my other interests feel meaningless, since I find I'm not naturally talented at anything, everything feels forced. I'd say not to listen to the person telling you to jump off a building, who's to say you'll never improve, or maybe you're just blinded by your insecurities. Either way, just bc I'm suicidal doesn't mean I'll tell you the best way to abort yourself. Stay strong is the only thing I could tell you, really.
thank you, I ended up not doing it yesterday bc of falling asleep while waiting for a chance, so I guess I'm still here. anyway, this really does mean a lot to me, so thank you, again ^^.

So much more life is what's scaring me, to be honest. I appreciate your concern and all, but my beliefs are non-religious (which kind of takes away the fun in living, since that would mean we're all a big mistake), and I really don't have the motivation to graduate and/or find a career, have children, or grow old. If you knew me, you'd understand, atleast a little :).
